featured_reviews.review_text:
Nice church to visit at Goragaon. They have a school attached to it.
The church complex is really nice and they have a good sized altar too.

featured_reviews.name: Atine De
featured_reviews.review_text: It's on a good location on MG road, goregaon west. The main altar is well designed. The sound system is good. Good singing by the choir at the nuptial mass. In the compound on the side is life size image of Christ the King. The front facade is good. The parish priest enforces his own rules in the celebration of mass and other sacraments according to his whims and fancies. It inconveniences the faithfuls. And this is happening in many parishes across the diocese. The head of the diocese should lay down a uniform set of rules and regulations to be strictly adhered to by all the parish priests of the diocese.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been attending st.anthony church sakinaka for the past 15 years, and it has been a truly enriching experience. The community is incredibly welcoming and supportive, making newcomers feel right at home. The services are inspiring and thought-provoking, with sermons that are both insightful and relevant to everyday life.

The pastoral team is genuinely caring and takes the time to get to know each member of the congregation. I also appreciate the variety of programs and activities available for all age groups, from children's ministries to adult Bible studies.

If you're looking for a place to grow spiritually and connect with a wonderful community, I highly recommend st Anthony church sakinaka
